title: DOS Algorithm Phase Manifest (RFC-0006 §6.1)
description: Declarative phase manifest. One per Algorithm phase. Compiles to a Markdown phase header block in v0.0.1.md. Required keys per RFC §6.1.

phase.description: Phase identifier, lowercase. Matches the canonical phase name (observe, think, plan, build, execute, verify, learn).

sequence.description: Phase sequence label rendered in the header (e.g. '1/7').

header_emoji.description: Emoji prefixing the phase header line.

voice_message.description: The exact string spoken when entering this phase. Surface contract — do not rewrite.

prd_updates.description: PRD frontmatter fields the phase MUST update on entry. Each value may contain {{token}} placeholders the compiler renders verbatim into the phase header instructions.

output_slots.description: Ordered list of OUTPUT slots the phase emits. Compiler renders each as a labelled bullet line in the OUTPUT block.

gates.description: Per-phase gates the algorithm MUST satisfy before exiting the phase. Compiler may emit them as a checklist; type-specific encoding is implementation-defined.

must_actions.description: Discrete must-actions the phase performs. Each is a stable identifier the compiler renders into the FIRST ACTION line.

raw_frontmatter.description: Reserved escape hatch. Implementations MUST preserve any unknown top-level keys verbatim per RFC §7.1.3.
